adjustment.analysis: The baseline median is 16.7. Thanksgiving is a strong driver with a noise-adjusted historical lift of x1.85, supported by two prior occurrences. The product is not on promotion (price unchanged), so no promotion lift. The 'TikTok trend' is unverified by sales data and likely noise; no past evidence links TikTok to sales spikes. The classical model’s x1.85 aligns with historical event effect. No offsetting factors (e.g., post-promo dip, price increase). No evidence of trend acceleration beyond seasonal ramp. Keep multiplier at x1.85. Spreads unchanged: baseline uncertainty is already calibrated.

It is the multiplier that would have been right, so it maps directly onto median_multiplier.
